sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:3

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:3:1
items.html: Though they are seven Melachim, they are ten. This means that not only do ZAT HGT NHYM of the Katnut contain Eser Sefirot as well, meaning Eser Sefirot in each contains HGT NHYM, but they also had a Zivug de Gadlut that have actual GAR, meaning HBD too.
